description: Verify that DUT ceases its claim and re-probes after two ARP Request conflicts on its committed Link-Local address (RFC 3927 §2.5, MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
After the claim is final, RFC 3927 §2.5 lets the host either DEFEND once or always-CEASE. The always-cease branch (DUT's choice here) abandons the LL on the first conflict. This case fires two conflicting ARP Requests claiming DUT's committed LL and asserts a fresh Probe targeting a different LL appears.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: OpStartLLAutoconf (kicks the Link-Local state machine)

2. DUT: 3 Probes → 1st Announce → SCXML transitions pre_claim → post_claim. Listening_post_claim entry observer fires:
   • UT-query DUT_LL → snapshot into Captured
   • Tester → DUT: 2 ARP Requests with sender == target == committed LL (spec step 9 + 11)

3. Observation (re-probe window):
   • DUT → wire: a fresh ARP Probe with target_proto_ip ≠ snapshotted committed LL   ← key check

[Pass condition]
Claim observed AND a fresh Probe with a different LL after the conflict.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_claim_observed — DUT did not announce its committed LL
• Fail_no_reprobe — DUT did not re-probe after the conflict ARP Requests

verdicts.Pass: DUT ceased its claim and re-probed after two ARP Request conflicts — normal
verdicts.Fail_no_claim_observed: DUT did not announce its committed Link-Local address
verdicts.Fail_no_reprobe: DUT did not re-probe after the conflict ARPs
